1: Your identity is safest in what Christ has done, not in how others react to you.
2: In Christ, failure is not your name and shame is not your future.
3: You are not abandoned when you belong to the Son.
4: Grace gives you a new standing before it changes every feeling within you.
5: The world assigns labels; Christ gives belonging.
6: You do not have to invent worth when it has already been given by God.
7: In Christ, your story is not trapped in its worst chapter.
8: Adoption by God speaks louder than rejection by people.
9: What Jesus calls redeemed should not live as if still discarded.
10: Your identity is received, not performed.
11: The cross settles what your value could never earn on its own.
12: Stand in who God says you are, not in what fear keeps accusing.
